body.title: Camel and tent
body.purpose: Practice saying where things are in Korean, using your desert camp.

instruction.text: 낙타를 텐트 왼쪽에 놓고 한국어로 말해 보세요.
instruction.gloss: Put the camel to the left of the tent, then say it in Korean.

hints.text: Start with the camel, then say where it is.
The place word comes right before 있어요.
